description: Steady C2 content batch for The Sound Maze. Each target is spoken aloud; the learner selects its spelling. Draft content is not wired into the live game.

questions.explain: Fathom begins with /æ/. Feather begins with /ɛ/, father with /ɑ/, and further with /ɜr/.
Livid begins with /ɪ/. Leaven begins with /ɛ/, lavish with /æ/, and lovely with /ʌ/.
Placid begins with /æ/. Pleasure begins with /ɛ/, while plunder and plummet begin with /ʌ/.
Psalter begins with /s/ because p is silent. Shelter begins with /ʃ/, salter has a different following sequence, and halter begins with /h/.
Czarina is commonly pronounced with initial /z/ in General American. Serene begins with /s/, arena with a vowel, and haughty with /h/.
Knoll begins with /n/ because k is silent. Coal begins with /k/, droll with /d/, and mole with /m/.
Quaffed ends with /ft/. Quaff ends with /f/, quaffs with /fs/, and quaffing with /fɪŋ/.
Dwelled ends with /ld/. Dwell ends with /l/, dwells with /lz/, and dwelling with /lɪŋ/.
Clasped ends with /pst/. Clasp ends with /sp/, clasps with /sps/, and clasping with /spɪŋ/.
Echelon is pronounced /ˈɛʃəlɑn/. Etching begins with /ɛtʃ/, echoing with /ɛk/, and election has a different medial sequence.
Faux is pronounced /foʊ/; x is silent. Fax, fox, and fall have different vowel and ending sounds.
Subpoena is pronounced /səˈpiːnə/. Subpoenas and subpoenaed have audible final additions; supernova has a different syllable and stress pattern.
